paragraphs.text: Denawa is the northern of the two main islands of Orvada , a merchant empire rivalling Benalia on Dominaria . The other island is Walassa , to the south.

Gerrard Capashen once visited Denawa. Traveling down the coast with some friends, he ran into a pack of scarmithals. The soldiers killed the beasts and took their hides, as wearing a scarmithal hide allows one to pass among them without notice.
After the second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria, the merchant lords of Orvada made peace with Benalia and furnished food and supplies to the Serran troops led by Lyra Dawnbringer .
